title: Complexe de De Rham à puissance divisée [conférence de 1976 à l’IHÉS] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Context: this page belongs to Grothendieck's notes for his 1976 IHÉS talk on the divided-power (PD) de Rham complex. The neighbouring pages are typed pages from an unrelated manuscript on ℓ-adic traces of automorphisms of group schemes over finite fields, reused as scrap paper. This page is a fragment of a classification of homomorphisms φ_α between two 'universal' PD-de Rham algebras A_k = A(S_k, S_k^+, T) and A_{k'}.

Reading of the setup (inferred): k{T} is the divided-power polynomial algebra in one variable T over a base k. A_k is a bigraded commutative differential graded algebra with divided powers, carrying an exterior (cohomological) grading and a total degree. It is generated by X_0 (essentially T, exterior degree 0) and X_1 (essentially dT, exterior degree 1), with divided-power monomials X_0^{(j)} X_1^{(h)}. A homomorphism φ_α is determined by a ring map φ_0 on scalars together with the images of the generators. These images are written A'_1 (the linear part of the image of the generator) and B'_i (the higher components), with coefficients α'_0 and α'_{i,j,h} in k'.

Results stated on the page:
(1) φ_α respects total degree iff three conditions hold: φ_0(k) = k', A'_1 = α'_0 X_0 with α'_0 ∈ k', and B'_i = Σ_{j+h=i−1} α'_{i,j,h} X_0^{(j)} X_1^{(h)} for i ≥ 1. A marginal note says these conditions are void if 2 is invertible in S'.
(2) φ_α commutes with both gradations (total and exterior) iff φ_0(k) ⊂ k', A'_1 = α'_0 X_0 and B'_i = 0 for i ≥ 1. Equivalently, it commutes with the exterior grading and with the increasing filtration. It then automatically respects divided powers ('pour mémoire').
(3) Consequently such φ_α correspond bijectively to pairs (φ_00 : k → k', α'_0 ∈ k'). They are exactly the maps A(S_k, S_k^+, T) → A(S_{k'}, S_{k'}^+, T) functorially induced by the morphism of PD-triples (u, α'_0) : (S_k, S_k^+, T) → (S_{k'}, S_{k'}^+, T). Here u : k{T} → k'{T} is φ_00 on scalars and sends T to α'_0 T.
(4) Part e) considers the decreasing filtration by total degree (by sub-S- or sub-S'-modules). φ_α respects it iff B'_i involves only monomials with j + h ≥ i − 1. The page calls this condition 'always satisfied, in particular if 2 is invertible'.

Purpose: the page determines the automorphism and functoriality group of the universal PD-de Rham complex of the PD affine line, presumably to pin down canonical structures (gradings and filtrations) on PD de Rham complexes for the crystalline / divided-power theory.
errors: The phrase 'conditions toujours vérifiées, en particulier si 2 inversible' is internally awkward. 'Always' makes the qualifier 'in particular if 2 is invertible' redundant. Probably the always-true part is meant for one range of indices and the 2-invertible case for another; it cannot be checked from this fragment.
In (1) the condition reads φ_0 k = k', but in (2) it reads φ_0 k ⊂ k'. The first is likely a slip for ⊂ (a ring map need not be surjective).
S'_k in the target triple should presumably be S_{k'}.

ideas.what: Classification of endomorphisms/homomorphisms of the universal PD-de Rham algebra of the divided-power line that respect total degree, the exterior grading, or the total-degree filtration.
ideas.modern_name: Functoriality/automorphisms of the PD de Rham complex Ω^•_{Γ(T)} (crystalline/PD de Rham theory)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Berthelot, Illusie (PD de Rham complexes, crystalline cohomology, 1970s)

ideas.what: Observation that maps compatible with both gradations automatically respect divided powers, and are induced by scalar maps plus scaling T ↦ α'_0 T.
ideas.modern_name: Graded automorphisms of the PD polynomial de Rham complex

missed.claim: The page documents the otherwise unpublished 1976 IHÉS lecture material on PD de Rham complexes: Grothendieck was working out the structure of a universal PD-de Rham algebra A(S, S^+, T) with total and exterior gradings. The computation itself is routine.
missed.quote: L'hom φ_α commute aux deux gradations (totale et extérieure) ssi ... B'_i = 0 (i≥1) (et donc il commute aux p.d. — pour mémoire!)
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: This is of historical interest only, as evidence of Grothendieck's involvement with PD de Rham structures around the time of Illusie's de Rham–Witt work.

deep.surprise_reason: This is a routine bookkeeping computation of graded homomorphisms of a PD-de Rham algebra. It is fragmentary and has no evident novel result.

Inserted text likely reads 'il commute à la graduation ext. et la filtration croissante, i.e. ssi on a'.
'ce sont les hom' should read 'ce sont les hom' (not 'ce [?]').
Target triple written (S'_k, S'^+_k, T) is probably (S_{k'}, S_{k'}^+, T).
